Instagram search tips
Small films post crew calls in Stories, Highlights and captions, not always in tagged posts. On each hashtag, switch to Recent and look for "crew call," "now hiring," "PA needed," "production designer," "script supervisor," and "seeking writers." Follow local indie accounts and festival pages, then DM or email the contact in the bio. Instagram isn't searchable from here, so I couldn't pull individual posts.
